title: 定积分与黎曼积分
html:
定积分与黎曼积分

核心概念

定积分是微积分的另一根支柱，它将"面积"的直觉概念精确化。黎曼积分通过将区间分割为小段、用矩形面积之和逼近曲线下方面积来定义：∫a^b f(x)dx = lim{n→∞} Σ f(ξᵢ)Δxᵢ。微积分基本定理（FTC）将积分与导数联系起来：如果 F'(x) = f(x)，则 ∫_a^b f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a)。

对程序员而言，定积分的计算在概率密度函数的归一化、信号处理的能量计算、机器学习的损失函数和期望值计算中无处不在。数值积分是将连续积分离散化的过程。

数值积分基础方法

梯形法则和 Simpson 法则是最基本的数值积分方法。梯形法用梯形逼近每个小区间，Simpson 法用抛物线逼近。

const trapezoidalRule = (f: (x: number) => number, a: number, b: number, n: number): number => {
  const h = (b - a) / n;
  let sum = (f(a) + f(b)) / 2;
  for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) sum += f(a + i * h);
  return sum * h;
};

const simpsonRule = (f: (x: number) => number, a: number, b: number, n: number): number => {
  if (n % 2 !== 0) n++;
  const h = (b - a) / n;
  let sum = f(a) + f(b);
  for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
    sum += (i % 2 === 0 ? 2 : 4) * f(a + i * h);
  }
  return (sum * h) / 3;
};

const gaussLegendre = (f: (x: number) => number, a: number, b: number, n: number = 5): number => {
  const nodes: Record<number, number[]> = {
    2: [-0.5773502692, 0.5773502692],
    3: [-0.7745966692, 0, 0.7745966692],
    5: [-0.9061798459, -0.5384693101, 0, 0.5384693101, 0.9061798459],
  };
  const weights: Record<number, number[]> = {
    2: [1, 1],
    3: [0.5555555556, 0.8888888889, 0.5555555556],
    5: [0.2369268851, 0.4786286705, 0.5688888889, 0.4786286705, 0.2369268851],
  };
  const ns = nodes[n] || nodes[5];
  const ws = weights[n] || weights[5];
  const mid = (a + b) / 2;
  const half = (b - a) / 2;
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ns.length; i++) {
    sum += ws[i] * f(mid + half * ns[i]);
  }
  return sum * half;
};

自适应积分

自适应积分根据被积函数的局部行为自动调整步长：在函数变化剧烈处使用更细的分割，在平缓处使用粗分割。核心思想是递归地比较粗积分和细积分的差异，如果差异超过容许误差则继续细分。

graph TD
    A[区间 a,b] --> B[计算粗积分 S₁]
    A --> C[计算细积分 S₂]
    B --> D{"|S₁-S₂| < ε?"}
    C --> D
    D -->|是| E[返回 S₂]
    D -->|否| F[分割为两半]
    F --> G[递归左半]
    F --> H[递归右半]
const adaptiveSimpson = (
  f: (x: number) => number,
  a: number,
  b: number,
  tolerance: number = 1e-10,
  maxDepth: number = 50,
): { value: number; evaluations: number } => {
  let evaluations = 0;
  const evalF = (x: number) => {
    evaluations++;
    return f(x);
  };

  const simpson = (a: number, b: number, fa: number, fb: number, fm: number): number => {
    return ((b - a) / 6) * (fa + 4 * fm + fb);
  };

  const recurse = (
    a: number,
    b: number,
    fa: number,
    fb: number,
    fm: number,
    whole: number,
    tol: number,
    depth: number,
  ): number => {
    const m = (a + b) / 2;
    const flm = evalF((a + m) / 2);
    const frm = evalF((m + b) / 2);
    const left = simpson(a, m, fa, fm, flm);
    const right = simpson(m, b, fm, fb, frm);
    const refined = left + right;

    if (depth >= maxDepth || Math.abs(refined - whole) <= 15 * tol) {
      return refined + (refined - whole) / 15;
    }

    return recurse(a, m, fa, fm, flm, left, tol / 2, depth + 1) + recurse(m, b, fm, fb, frm, right, tol / 2, depth + 1);
  };

  const fa = evalF(a);
  const fb = evalF(b);
  const fm = evalF((a + b) / 2);
  const whole = simpson(a, b, fa, fb, fm);
  const value = recurse(a, b, fa, fb, fm, whole, tolerance, 0);
  return { value, evaluations };
};

积分在概率论中的应用

概率论中大量计算涉及积分：概率密度函数的归一化 ∫f(x)dx = 1、期望值 E[X] = ∫xf(x)dx、方差 Var(X) = ∫(x-μ)²f(x)dx。这些积分通常没有解析解，需要数值方法。

const normalPDF = (x: number, mu: number = 0, sigma: number = 1): number =>
  Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mu) / sigma) ** 2) / (sigma * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));

const numericalExpectation = (
  pdf: (x: number) => number,
  g: (x: number) => number,
  lower: number,
  upper: number,
): number => {
  const integrand = (x: number) => g(x) * pdf(x);
  return adaptiveSimpson(integrand, lower, upper).value;
};

const numericalVariance = (pdf: (x: number) => number, lower: number, upper: number): number => {
  const mean = numericalExpectation(pdf, (x) => x, lower, upper);
  return numericalExpectation(pdf, (x) => (x - mean) ** 2, lower, upper);
};

const numericalCDF = (pdf: (x: number) => number, x: number, lower: number = -10): number =>
  adaptiveSimpson(pdf, lower, x).value;

  • 定积分通过黎曼和将面积概念精确化，FTC 连接了积分与导数
  • 梯形法 O(h²) 和 Simpson 法 O(h⁴) 是最常用的数值积分方法
  • 自适应积分自动调整步长，在保证精度的同时减少计算量
  • 概率论中的期望、方差和 CDF 计算本质上都是数值积分问题
  • Gauss 求积在同等函数评估次数下达到最高精度
